Listing says 'Formerly the Texas Division of Jeans Waterproofing, Incorporated' so this is a split-off from a parent of the same name, ownership history unknown (not checked for sale). Location conflict: db city New Braunfels, LeadIQ and Blue Book also say New Braunfels, MapQuest says McQueeney (a small town near New Braunfels), Levelset lists Plano. PPP in db: 170 jobs reported (April 2020, NAICS 238320), the largest of my companies, so size is worth a check. Do not confuse with Jeans Waterproofing Inc. projects in Pittsburgh PA. Owner history: Tom DiPippo owner in 2014 (PR Log), ZoomInfo shows a Thomas DePippo as owner until 2023 and a Lynda DePippo as owner, so a handover in or around 2023 is possible but unproven. LinkedIn company page: privately held, founded 2006, 11 to 50 employees, versus 170 jobs on the 2020 PPP loan. A LinkedIn post in search results announces that Thomas DePippo joined Mobile Enterprises to expand in Central and South Texas, which fits the ZoomInfo end date of 2023 as Jeans owner and suggests Jeans changed hands or leadership; no source names a buyer. Blue Book project pages (search text) show the firm on the Old Dallas Municipal Building restoration with 'the extensive restoration waterproofing scope' and on the John H. Winters Building, which supports exterior restoration work; tier left adjacent because the listing's own scope is industrial and commercial. The 170 jobs on the April 2020 PPP loan is not credible: a $164,400 loan implies about $789,000 annual payroll, about $4,600 a job. Replaced with the LinkedIn company band seen in search text. No estimate is made. Headquarters conflict stays open: MapQuest says McQueeney; LinkedIn, PPP and Blue Book say New Braunfels. jwtexas.com could not be read (certificate mismatch).
